_note: Community ESTIMATEs (public RHA-equivalent guesses, not official data) and DESIGN values (no estimate found, chosen for play).
One mm RHA-equivalent per box face, as protection against a hit square to that face; obliquity to the face adds 1/cos.
Every value says which it is in 'sources'. No War Thunder game data is used.
